title: Finite Fourier Duality, Radial Values, and Arithmetic of a Mod Eight False Theta Quotient
summary: We study a family of mod-eight false-theta moment quotients and determine their radial behaviour at every root of unity. The main structural result establishes an exact finite Fourier closure for the associated periodic boundary sequences. This closure yields a completed functional equation and proves the nonvanishing of the relevant periodic Dirichlet values at all negative odd integers. Consequently, each quotient exhibits either universal normalized factorial asymptotics or a finite nonzero radial value.
